title: Mike Vrabel: Christian Gonzalez was "physically unavailable" for practice this week

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Mike Vrabel: Christian Gonzalez was "physically unavailable" for practice this week
sources.description: Patriots cornerback Christian Gonzalez joined the rest of the team's starters in not playing against the Colts on Thursday night and he didn't take part in a joint practice on Tuesday either.
